newsitem.title: USA: N.J. panel approves funds for tunnel plan -- paper.
newsitem.headline: N.J. panel approves funds for tunnel plan -- paper.

text.p: A New Jersey legislative committee approved an increasse in transportation spending that will partly pay for a $330 million Atlantic City tunnel, the Philadelphia Inquirer reported Friday.

The joint session of the New Jersey Senate and Assembly Transportation Committees okayed the bill, which includes the state's share of the tunnel project as part of an overall $1.8 billion transportation spending plan.
The bill includes a one-time $200 million increase in the amount the state can tap from the Transportation Trust Fund, from $700 million to $900 million.

Developer Donald Trump has filed a lawsuit to stop the tunnel project, which he said unfairly benefits his casino rivals in the city. The state Thursday filed a motion to dismiss the suit in federal court.
